conversationalSummary.text: TODAY after work (around a 17:00 start) at Cerro is worth checking, mainly because the swell looks usable and Surfline’s been a bit more consistent than the wider surf-forecast. Wind is a bit mixed and the tide’s dropping, so it could get sharp in exposed patches, and there’s also the usual rocks factor to keep in mind. Before I leave I’ll check Surfline and the MEO Beachcam for Cerro—if they don’t look clearly cleaner than expected, I’m likely to cancel and save the session.

best.explanation: Cerro looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 122 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 78/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Expect: it can feel softer or less defined than the main peaks, and rocks may appear closer to the west cliffs.
